solution_summary: Avanade built its Microsoft solution to improve enterprise data-platform modernization. "The first step is to help them create a strong data foundation for AI solutions and other advanced technologies." To make this possible, Avanade needed to upskill its own employees at scale with hands-on training in data migration and advanced data analytics platforms. Key components included Microsoft Fabric held and organized governed data, and Microsoft OneLake held and organized governed data. Operational data flows into Microsoft Fabric, where Microsoft Fabric applies transformations and business logic before Power BI delivers governed insights to teams across Avanade. The governed Microsoft stack gave Avanade a reusable foundation for data analytics, data platform while keeping deployment, security, and day-to-day operations inside the Microsoft estate. It provided customized, enhanced data analytics training to 30,000 employees.
